validity.recommendation: check the start year: the cited Gazprom text says the first stage began supplying gas in December 2007, not 2009
validity.researcher_notes: The first stage is real, 26.6 km, and has supplied Bratsk since December 2007 according to a Gazprom press service text. Gazprom Transgaz Tomsk built it. The sheet start year of 2009 conflicts with the page it cites. The Finam item that the wiki cites for 325 mm could not be read.

verifications.note: Протяженность первой очереди газопровода составила 26,6 км

fills.researcher_notes: m.baikal-daily.ru item of 22 December 2009 (Gazprom press service text): in December 2007 the first stage of the Bratskoye gas field to Bratsk trunk line was completed up to micro-district 45 of Bratsk and gas supply to the city began. The first stage is 26.6 km long. The finished line is to be about 70 km. The 26.6 km matches the sheet. The Tomsk Transgaz history page says about 26 km, which agrees.

verifications.note: В декабре 2007 года было завершено строительство первой очереди ... и начата подача газа в город

fills.researcher_notes: m.baikal-daily.ru item of 22 December 2009 (Gazprom press service text): in December 2007 the first stage of the Bratskoye gas field to Bratsk trunk line was completed up to micro-district 45 of Bratsk and gas supply to the city began. The first stage is 26.6 km long. The finished line is to be about 70 km. The sheet says 2009. The same item dates a separate 9.2 km village line to December 2009 and a gas supply start to the village of Zyaba to November 2009, so 2009 looks like a mix-up with later lines. Proposed start is December 2007 as the page states. The old value 2009 is kept in this note.

verifications.note: Газификация Братска началась в 2009 г. на базе Братского ГКМ ... Правобережный

fills.researcher_notes: Two publishers. The 2009 item above says gas supply to Bratsk began in December 2007. A Neftegaz.ru item of 17 November 2022, read as the Wayback capture of 27 January 2023, says Bratsk gasification began in 2009 from the Bratskoye gas field and that the existing pipes serve the right bank district only, using about 10 percent of the field's capacity. Both support an operating first stage.

fills.researcher_notes: The company history page of Gazprom Transgaz Tomsk (Wayback capture of 1 May 2025) lists, among its projects from 2000 to 2011, building the gas pipeline from the Bratskoye gas field to Bratsk, about 26 km, and opening the Bratsk gas distribution station. It names the company as builder and does not use the word operator, so the tier is medium.

fills.researcher_notes: The sheet names the parent, Gazprom PJSC. The company history page of Gazprom Transgaz Tomsk (Wayback capture of 1 May 2025) says that subsidiary carried out the construction of this pipeline, so the lower-level holder is proposed. The page does not state ownership in words, so the tier is medium. The old value was Gazprom PJSC at 100 percent.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: Gas supply began in December 2007. The newest readable item, from November 2022, still describes the pipes serving the right bank. The 2024 and 2025 items say gas is already used in the right bank district.

cross_row_leads.facts: Open-web check: the Finam item of December 2007 that the wiki cites for 325 mm diameter. Look for the same Gazprom press release elsewhere to confirm the diameter, which is blank on the sheet.
